rungs.label: What our sourced Brazil routes support today
rungs.note: Navier's annual revenue across the sourced Brazil routes at full fleet (199 boats): the four Rio cross-bay routes, Angra dos Reis–Abraão, and the two Florianópolis corridors. Florianópolis volumes are a government pre-viability projection. This is the grounded floor, not the whole market.

rungs.label: Matured Brazil network Navier can serve
rungs.note: Navier's own transport revenue once the full addressable Brazilian network runs at leading-operator capture, with faster, more comfortable boats growing the market. Mid case shown with a low–high range.

rungs.label: Brazil marine-mobility opportunity
rungs.note: Total annual water-transfer spend the induced Brazilian crossing market can support at full network width.

rungs.label: Whole-journey value across those crossings
rungs.note: Door-to-door value of every journey that includes one of these crossings — the full trip DiDi's app coordinates end to end, not only the boat leg.

rungs.label: DiDi platform revenue on the Navier network
rungs.note: DiDi's platform take on the journey value routed through the Navier network, at DiDi's standard 18% commission.
